defects.title: Real-provider authentication journeys not freshly verified
defects.userImpact: Cannot claim hosted sign-in/sign-up readiness from synthetic JWT alone.
defects.expected: Synthetic and provider-authenticated sign-in/up/recovery/sign-out pass on nominated environments.
defects.observed: Phase 65 exercised synthetic JWT API journeys only; no owner preview login credentials used.
reproduction: Run CORE_E2E — passes with injected JWT.
Attempt real hosted preview login without provided test account — not executed.
defects.workaround: Use local synthetic auth for engineering validation only.
defects.dependency: Owner-authorized synthetic preview account (no passwords in chat).
defects.nextAction: Phase 72 exercises provider auth with disposable credentials when provided.

defects.title: Hosted core preview disables files, audio, and reminder delivery
defects.userImpact: Users on free hosted preview cannot upload files, attach audio, or receive reminders.
defects.expected: Documented preview limits; full capability on non-preview environments after gates.
defects.observed: Hosted/core preview still disables upload/audio UI (isCorePreview). Local non-preview API journeys pass with MemoryStorageProvider + PolicyMalwareScanner (explicit non-prod opt-in). live-storage-capabilities.test.ts remains mocked fetch transport — not live Supabase. Physical Android capture/playback evidence still required for Phase 75 completion.
defects.workaround: Use local non-preview builds for file/audio engineering tests.
defects.dependency: Preview scope honesty; Phases 75/84 for readiness.
defects.nextAction: Keep preview claims accurate. Unblock Phase 75 with physical Android mic/browser capture evidence and/or authorized live storage+scanner environment; do not enable hosted preview uploads solely to pass tests.

defects.title: Cold offline reopen serves public offline page, not private organizer
defects.userImpact: Previously authorized trusted device cannot reopen local organizer when fully offline on an installed PWA or self-contained native build.
defects.expected: Safe public shell unlocks account-scoped local data without caching private HTML/API; proven on installed production PWA and installed native build.
defects.observed: Closed locally 2026-10-27: installed production Next PWA cold reopen (Edge isolated profile) and Metro-free embedded x86_64 emulator APK cold launch passed. Fixture remains supplementary only. Physical-device native cold launch not claimed.
reproduction: Install production PWA (not static fixture alone)
Seed trusted consent + offline_boot + local records online
Terminate process, go fully offline, cold reopen
Repeat on self-contained native installed build
defects.environment: local-windows-edge-cdp-installed-pwa; emulator-5554 daynori_vault_api35 embedded-x86_64; local GoTrue+API
defects.nextAction: Optional: record physical-device native cold launch before release_ready claims.

defects.title: Production vault unlock blocked pending independent review
defects.userImpact: Encrypted vault is not available as a released feature.
defects.expected: Vault unlock only after independent security/recovery gates.
defects.observed: Settings states production unlock disabled; API vault status 403 in production validation.
defects.workaround: Use synthetic harness only for engineering.
defects.nextAction: Keep vault off; close gates in Phase 86.

defects.title: Live Google Drive connection not verified
defects.userImpact: Drive connector cannot be claimed ready without live OAuth.

defects.title: Developer/harness surfaces reachable from ordinary Settings
defects.userImpact: Ordinary users must not see developer galleries, vault harness, or provisional integration controls in everyday Settings.
defects.expected: Developer tools restricted by platform-operator allowlist; direct URL/API/deep-link denied; production gates stay closed.
defects.observed: Phase 66: ordinary Settings omits gallery/harness/provisional panels; /v1/operator/session denies non-operators; OperatorGate on /developer, /review, /dev/vault-harness; mobile operator gating via allowlist. Physical Android operator grant and production staff IdP remain unmet evidence — not release_ready.

Direct /developer without allowlist → denial UI (no privileged flash)
defects.dependency: Physical device + production operator identity for full cross-platform closure.
defects.nextAction: Keep DEF-V2-010 open for unmet physical/production operator evidence; local web/API/domain boundaries verified in Phase 66.
